answers.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
answers.evidence: Of 32 judged findings (tool findings F-0015, F-0018, F-0019 excluded), 26 map to seeded defects, 5 are real-unseeded and 1 is not-a-problem (F-0058): precision 31/32 = 0.97, strict precision 26/32 = 0.81. Recall by meaning: 13/14 across all findings (only D13, the slot length in a tooltip, is missed); 11/14 from judged findings alone (D02 and D11 come only from tool findings).

answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply has a numbered 'What to fix first' list that starts with the top-severity double-tap problem, followed by 'Next round, also high priority'. Under 'Some things can't be checked by machine and need a person' it lists VoiceOver/TalkBack in dark mode, real 200% zoom and IME typing, and it says 'Nothing has been tried with residents yet.'

mapping.title: Amber tag contrast 3.02:1
mapping.reason: Amber text (#bd7d0f) on an amber tint (#fbefda) at 16 px bold measures 3.02:1, below 4.5:1. That is the 'Few left' tag contrast failure.

mapping.title: Horizontal page overflow at 320 px
mapping.reason: The slot grid runs 15 px past a 320 px viewport and the page scrolls sideways. That is the seeded grid overflow at 360 px and below.

mapping.title: No visible focus on slot button 08:00
mapping.reason: Tab focus on the 08:00 slot changes no pixels, so the slot buttons show no focus.

mapping.title: Focus order jumps back to 08:20 Few left
mapping.reason: Focus jumps around the grid because the 'Few left' slots are shown out of document order. That is the reordering defect.

mapping.title: Cancelled page keeps heading 'Booked'
mapping.reason: The cancelled state comes from the second press on Book. D09 names the harm: the done page still says 'Booked', so the resident goes to the gate with a cancelled booking. This item is a narrower statement of that harm.

mapping.title: Cancelled page title reads 'Booked'
mapping.reason: Same harm as D09: after the double-press cancellation, the done page is still titled 'Booked'.

mapping.title: Expired-slot error gives no recovery and no link
mapping.reason: When the hold lapses, the error says only 'This slot is no longer available.' and the slot line becomes a dash, without saying what happened or what to do. That is the expired-hold defect.

mapping.title: Selected day nearly invisible under forced colours
mapping.reason: Under forced colours, the chosen day button differs from the others only by a 2 px border instead of 1 px. A low-vision resident using high-contrast mode cannot see which day is selected without reading the heading below. Minor, because the day is also named in text, but measured and not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: Second press on Book cancels the booking
mapping.reason: A second press during the 1.5 s wait relabels the button 'Cancel booking' and saves the booking as cancelled. This is exactly D09.

mapping.title: Book shows no pending state for 1.5 s
mapping.reason: Book stays enabled with no busy state or label change. D09 includes 'Book doing nothing visible'.

mapping.title: Slots have no loading state; Next does nothing
mapping.reason: The grid and status line stay blank for about 0.9 s with nothing marking the wait, and Next silently does nothing. That is the wait itself.

mapping.title: Today's past slots offered, refused after Book
mapping.reason: Today's slots before the cut-off show as free and are refused only after Book, once the details are entered.

mapping.title: Permit checked only after Book, not on vehicle step
mapping.reason: Next on the vehicle step accepts a missing or malformed permit, and the rule is enforced only on the confirm page, which has no permit field.

mapping.title: Post-Book errors (permit etc.) not linked to fix
mapping.reason: Its main example is the permit error on the confirm page (states 'permit-error', 'van, permit 12345'). That page has no permit field and no link back, so the resident has to find the way back alone, which is part of D07.

mapping.title: 5-minute hold expires without warning
mapping.reason: No page announces, shows or extends the five-minute hold, and the slot is dropped when it lapses.

mapping.title: Vehicle-step error links target non-focusable divs
mapping.reason: The error-summary links on the vehicle step point at a div role=group and a plain div, so focus does not land on a control. Keyboard and screen-reader residents are not taken to the vehicle buttons or waste checkboxes they need to fix. Not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: Permit field shown for Car with no 'vans only' note
mapping.reason: The permit rule is not stated at the field and is only behind the icon-only info button. That is the D07 permit-rule problem.

mapping.title: Done page omits day, time and vehicle
mapping.reason: The done page does not restate the booked day, slot window or vehicle.

mapping.title: 'Change slot' opens a blank first step
mapping.reason: 'Change slot' opens the first step on Today with no slot chosen, so the chosen day and slot are forgotten.

mapping.title: Permit field labelled the same for every vehicle
mapping.reason: The rule that only vans and trailers need a permit is only in the Opening days box and behind the icon-only info button, not at the field. That is D07.

mapping.title: Permit rule hidden behind (i) button
mapping.reason: This is D07's core: the permit requirement is stated only behind an icon-only info button.

mapping.title: Permit help has no link and no timing
mapping.reason: The help says to apply on the council site but gives no link and does not say whether a permit can arrive in time. A van owner booking the evening before cannot act on it. Fixing D07 would not fix this, so it is separate.

mapping.title: Vehicle step does not repeat chosen day/slot
mapping.reason: Choosing a vehicle does not depend on the slot, and the confirm page restates the day and slot before anything is booked. The item names no harm to residents.

mapping.title: No online way to change or cancel a booking
mapping.reason: Changing or cancelling is possible only by phone, on weekdays 09:00 to 17:00. Residents who book in the evening or at weekends cannot free or move their slot, so it is wasted or they miss their visit. Not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: Flow never says how long a slot is held
mapping.reason: No screen gives the hold time or a countdown. That is the unseen five-minute hold.

mapping.title: No online change or cancel (duplicate)
mapping.reason: Same problem as F-0067: only a weekday phone line, outside the evening and weekend times when residents book or change plans.

mapping.title: No indication of hold time
mapping.reason: No page states a hold time or time remaining, and the confirm page can fail with 'This slot is no longer available'. That is D08.

mapping.title: 'Few left' slots pulled into an unlabelled top group
mapping.reason: The 'Few left' slots are moved to the front of the grid, out of time order, and the Morning and Afternoon headings no longer sit above their slots.

mapping.title: Done page omits day, slot and vehicle
mapping.reason: The done page shows only 'Booked', the reference and generic instructions, with no day, slot or vehicle.

mapping.title: Expired hold keeps 'Book this slot' as primary
mapping.reason: After the hold lapses, the slot shows as a dash and the page gives no way forward. This is the expired-hold harm in D08.

mapping.title: Permit field shown before vehicle; rule behind (i)
mapping.reason: The permit rule is not stated at the field and sits only behind the (i) button. That is D07.

mapping.title: Slot grid wider than page at 320 px
mapping.reason: At 320 px the third slot column reaches past the content edge and the capture is 335 px wide. That is the grid overflow.

mapping.title: Slot count status not announced
mapping.reason: The live region is added together with '20 slots free…', so screen readers are not told the slots or their count.

mapping.title: No progress during 1.2 s 'Car with trailer'
mapping.reason: Choosing a vehicle that needs a permit starts a 1.2 s wait with no feedback before the permit field appears. That is D07's delayed permit field.

mapping.title: Layout shift 0.169 moving #opening
mapping.reason: A lab CLS of 0.169, above the 0.1 budget, when the slots arrive and push #opening down. That is the page-moving defect.
